findings.summary: Cleaning dot-dot before resolving intermediate symlinks can validate a different path from the raw target restored by Root.Symlink, allowing an out-of-root or dangling link.
findings.correction: Resolve components and symlinks in filesystem order before checking boundary/existence, or reject unsupported complex targets.

findings.summary: Preflight only scans declared central-directory length, while archive/zip may consume further contiguous headers and allocate them before the post-read entry limit.
findings.correction: Validate the complete region actually consumed by archive/zip and reject inconsistent declared layout before standard-library allocation.
